<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="1920" height="1080" viewBox="0 0 1920 1080">
<defs>
  <linearGradient id="bg" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1"><stop stop-color="#0c1322"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#030712"/></linearGradient>
  <radialGradient id="earth"><stop stop-color="#475569"/><stop offset=".7" stop-color="#263345"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#152033"/></radialGradient>
  <marker id="arrow" markerWidth="11" markerHeight="11" refX="9" refY="5" orient="auto" markerUnits="strokeWidth"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10" fill="none" stroke="#E5A158" stroke-width="1.4"/></marker>
</defs>
<rect width="1920" height="1080" fill="url(#bg)"/>
<path d="M110 119H1810" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="2"/>
<path d="M110 119H310" stroke="#E5A158" stroke-width="5"/>
<g font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" fill="#FFFFFF">
<text x="110" y="218" font-size="62" font-weight="700">THE RIGHT MACHINE. THE WRONG ORBIT.</text>
<text x="113" y="277" font-size="35" fill="#CBD5E1">The communications hardware worked. Its position made it unusable.</text>

<rect x="110" y="335" width="810" height="574" rx="14" fill="#0c1322" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="2"/>
<rect x="1000" y="335" width="810" height="574" rx="14" fill="#0c1322" stroke="#BF6D2C" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="155" y="399" font-size="34" letter-spacing="2" fill="#CBD5E1">WHERE THEY ENDED UP</text>
<text x="1045" y="399" font-size="34" letter-spacing="2" fill="#F6C383">WHERE THEY NEEDED TO BE</text>
<ellipse cx="515" cy="605" rx="250" ry="130" fill="none" stroke="#94A3B8" stroke-width="4" stroke-dasharray="12 13" transform="rotate(-19 515 605)"/>
<circle cx="515" cy="605" r="86" fill="url(#earth)" stroke="#64748B" stroke-width="2"/>
<path d="M437 605Q515 637 593 605M462 550Q515 586 568 550M463 660Q515 625 568 660" fill="none" stroke="#64748B" stroke-width="2" opacity=".55"/>
<circle cx="734" cy="515" r="10" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
<circle cx="302" cy="698" r="10" fill="#CBD5E1"/>
<text x="515" y="791" text-anchor="middle" font-size="43">Low, elongated orbits</text>
<text x="515" y="849" text-anchor="middle" font-size="30" fill="#94A3B8">Unable to serve their intended regions</text>
<ellipse cx="1405" cy="605" rx="270" ry="129" fill="none" stroke="#E5A158" stroke-width="5"/>
<circle cx="1405" cy="605" r="86" fill="url(#earth)" stroke="#64748B" stroke-width="2"/>
<path d="M1319 605H1491" stroke="#F6C383" stroke-width="3"/>
<text x="1405" y="664" text-anchor="middle" font-size="22" fill="#CBD5E1">EARTH</text>
<circle cx="1675" cy="605" r="11" fill="#F6C383"/>
<text x="1405" y="790" text-anchor="middle" font-size="43" fill="#F6C383">Geostationary orbit</text>
<text x="1405" y="849" text-anchor="middle" font-size="32">22,300 miles above the equator</text>
<text x="110" y="986" font-size="29" letter-spacing="1.2" fill="#94A3B8">SCHEMATIC — NOT TO SCALE · ORBITS SHOWN OBLIQUELY</text>

</g></svg>
assets.origin: Plotquake original explanatory diagram based on NASA STS-41B Mission Report (March 1984) and STS-51A mission history; research dossier S02 and S15.
assets.caption: The right machine, the wrong orbit
assets.changes: Original vector comparison; orbit geometry and distances explicitly schematic and not to scale; geostationary equatorial location identified. No purported spacecraft photography.

assets.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="1920" height="1080" viewBox="0 0 1920 1080">
<defs>
  <linearGradient id="bg" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1"><stop stop-color="#0c1322"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#030712"/></linearGradient>
  <radialGradient id="earth"><stop stop-color="#475569"/><stop offset=".7" stop-color="#263345"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#152033"/></radialGradient>
  <marker id="arrow" markerWidth="11" markerHeight="11" refX="9" refY="5" orient="auto" markerUnits="strokeWidth"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10" fill="none" stroke="#E5A158" stroke-width="1.4"/></marker>
</defs>
<rect width="1920" height="1080" fill="url(#bg)"/>
<path d="M110 119H1810" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="2"/>
<path d="M110 119H310" stroke="#E5A158" stroke-width="5"/>
<g font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" fill="#FFFFFF">
<text x="110" y="218" font-size="62" font-weight="700">THE SATELLITE WAS STILL WORKING</text>
<text x="113" y="277" font-size="35" fill="#CBD5E1">Three different pieces of hardware had different jobs.</text>

<rect x="110" y="365" width="470" height="444" rx="14" fill="#0c1322" stroke="#475569" stroke-width="2"/>
<rect x="725" y="365" width="470" height="444" rx="14" fill="#0c1322" stroke="#E5A158" stroke-width="3"/>
<rect x="1340" y="365" width="470" height="444" rx="14" fill="#0c1322" stroke="#475569" stroke-width="2"/>
<path d="M605 581H697" stroke="#E5A158" stroke-width="4" fill="none" marker-end="url(#arrow)"/>
<path d="M1220 581H1312" stroke="#E5A158" stroke-width="4" fill="none" marker-end="url(#arrow)"/>
<text x="153" y="431" font-size="28" letter-spacing="3" fill="#94A3B8">DELIVERY VEHICLE</text>
<text x="768" y="431" font-size="28" letter-spacing="3" fill="#F6C383">SEPARATE UPPER STAGE</text>
<text x="1383" y="431" font-size="28" letter-spacing="3" fill="#94A3B8">WORKING PAYLOAD</text>
<text x="153" y="520" font-size="55" font-weight="700">SHUTTLE</text>
<text x="768" y="520" font-size="55" font-weight="700">PAM-D</text>
<text x="1383" y="520" font-size="55" font-weight="700">SATELLITE</text>
<text x="153" y="628" font-size="36"><tspan x="153">Delivered the payload</tspan><tspan x="153" dy="48">to low Earth orbit</tspan></text>
<text x="768" y="628" font-size="36"><tspan x="768">Meant to raise</tspan><tspan x="768" dy="48">the satellite's orbit</tspan></text>
<text x="1383" y="628" font-size="36"><tspan x="1383">Healthy hardware</tspan><tspan x="1383" dy="48">in the wrong orbit</tspan></text>
<text x="153" y="754" font-size="31" fill="#CBD5E1">DEPLOYMENT SUCCEEDED</text>
<text x="768" y="754" font-size="31" fill="#F6C383">BURN FAILED</text>
<text x="1383" y="754" font-size="31" fill="#CBD5E1">THE OBJECT RETRIEVED</text>
<path d="M110 870H1810" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="110" y="930" font-size="34" fill="#F6C383">AKM: the satellite's own apogee motor</text>
<text x="110" y="984" font-size="30" fill="#CBD5E1">A different motor from the failed PAM-D. Its nozzle became the capture point.</text>

</g></svg>
assets.origin: Plotquake original explanatory diagram based on NASA STS-41B and STS-51A Mission Reports; research dossier S02 and S15.
assets.caption: The satellite and its failed upper stage were different hardware
assets.changes: Original functional block diagram separating Shuttle, failed PAM-D upper stage and healthy communications satellite; identifies the satellite AKM nozzle as the later capture point. No invented mechanical drawing.

display.author: Plotquake
display.title: The satellite and its failed upper stage were different hardware

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="1920" height="1080" viewBox="0 0 1920 1080">

  <linearGradient id="bg" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1"><stop stop-color="#0c1322"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#030712"/></linearGradient>

  <marker id="arrow" markerWidth="11" markerHeight="11" refX="9" refY="5" orient="auto" markerUnits="strokeWidth"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10" fill="none" stroke="#E5A158" stroke-width="1.4"/></marker>
</defs>
<rect width="1920" height="1080" fill="url(#bg)"/>
<path d="M110 119H1810" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="2"/>
<path d="M110 119H310" stroke="#E5A158" stroke-width="5"/>
<g font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" fill="#FFFFFF">
<text x="110" y="218" font-size="62" font-weight="700">BACK IN SERVICE</text>
<text x="113" y="277" font-size="35" fill="#CBD5E1">Recovery preserved the hardware. Refurbishment and new launches gave it another job.</text>

<rect x="110" y="354" width="1700" height="249" rx="14" fill="#0c1322" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="2"/>
<rect x="110" y="657" width="1700" height="249" rx="14" fill="#0c1322" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="2"/>
<path d="M532 480H678" stroke="#E5A158" stroke-width="4" fill="none" marker-end="url(#arrow)"/>
<path d="M1112 480H1238" stroke="#E5A158" stroke-width="4" fill="none" marker-end="url(#arrow)"/>
<path d="M532 783H678" stroke="#E5A158" stroke-width="4" fill="none" marker-end="url(#arrow)"/>
<path d="M1112 783H1238" stroke="#E5A158" stroke-width="4" fill="none" marker-end="url(#arrow)"/>
<text x="155" y="464" font-size="48" font-weight="700">WESTAR 6</text>
<text x="155" y="526" font-size="31" fill="#94A3B8">Stranded in February 1984</text>
<text x="725" y="453" font-size="29" letter-spacing="1.5" fill="#CBD5E1">RETURNED TO EARTH</text>
<text x="725" y="512" font-size="40" fill="#F6C383">NOVEMBER 1984</text>
<text x="1280" y="447" font-size="49" font-weight="700" fill="#F6C383">ASIASAT 1</text>
<text x="1280" y="506" font-size="34">April 7, 1990</text>
<text x="1280" y="551" font-size="28" fill="#94A3B8">Relaunched for service in Asia</text>
<text x="155" y="767" font-size="48" font-weight="700">PALAPA B2</text>
<text x="155" y="829" font-size="31" fill="#94A3B8">Stranded in February 1984</text>
<text x="725" y="756" font-size="29" letter-spacing="1.5" fill="#CBD5E1">RETURNED TO EARTH</text>
<text x="725" y="815" font-size="40" fill="#F6C383">NOVEMBER 1984</text>
<text x="1280" y="750" font-size="49" font-weight="700" fill="#F6C383">PALAPA B2R</text>
<text x="1280" y="809" font-size="34">April 13, 1990</text>
<text x="1280" y="854" font-size="28" fill="#94A3B8">Relaunched for Indonesia</text>
<text x="110" y="986" font-size="30" fill="#94A3B8">MORE THAN FIVE YEARS BETWEEN RECOVERY AND RELAUNCH</text>

</g></svg>
assets.origin: Plotquake original explanatory diagram based on AsiaSat operational history and NASA Aeronautics and Space Report launch table; research dossier S22 and S24.
assets.caption: The recovered satellites returned to service in 1990
assets.changes: Original two-track chronology; distinguishes recovered Palapa B2R (April 13, 1990) from the separate B2P launch; AsiaSat 1 relaunch April 7, 1990.

display.author: Plotquake
display.title: The recovered satellites returned to service in 1990
